boundary: The reachable geometries from a lattice of rank r are W(k-1,p) with k = r/deg(Phi_d) and p = Phi_d(1), reading as n = r/(2 deg(Phi_d)) qudits. For Leech the complete list after arithmetic, uniformity AND existence filters is exactly W(11,2) and W(5,2). Four and five qubits are unreachable from rank 24

design_tool.example: four qubits needs deg(Phi_d) = r/8: impossible at r=24, but deg 4 at r=32, i.e. d=8 -- a rank-32 lattice is where four qubits could live
design_tool.read_backwards: to realise n qudits of dimension q, need rank r = 2 n deg(Phi_d) with Phi_d(1) = q

projection.reading: W(11,2) projects ONTO W(5,2): six qubits onto three, induced by squaring the order-8 element. A projection, not an embedding
